title: Weekly check-in, Lantern Loop app team
fictional: Every person, company and amount in this call is made up. Voices are macOS text-to-speech.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Morning both. Quick weekly check-in. Theo, how is the export bug looking?

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Theo (engineer)
lines.text: I found it. The CSV export breaks on dates before the year two thousand. I'll have the fix merged by Thursday.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Nice work. Can you also add a test for old dates, so it doesn't come back?

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Theo (engineer)
lines.text: Yes, the test goes in with the same fix.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Great. Mara, where are we on the onboarding emails?

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Mara (marketing)
lines.text: The drafts are done. I need the final pricing before I can send them for review.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Let's decide that now. We keep the price at nine dollars a month for the launch.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Mara (marketing)
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll send the onboarding emails for review by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Theo (engineer)
lines.text: One more thing. With the fix landing Thursday, should we still launch on the twelfth?

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: No, let's move the launch to the eighteenth, so we get a full week of testing.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Mara (marketing)
lines.text: Agreed. I'll update the launch checklist today.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Perfect. I'll send the recap to both of you after this call. Thanks, everyone.
